{{Top|leg}}
A '''space shear''' was a type of spatial anomaly found near [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] storms which was encountered in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Some shears were strong enough to destroy a class-A [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], and due to this risk of destruction, [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] would alter their courses by thousands of [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in order to avoid a shear.

==History==
In their escape from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Acherin]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ferus Olin]], [[Raina Quill]], [[Toma (resistance leader)|Toma]], and [[Trever Flume]] encountered space shears on the edge of one such atmospheric storm. This storm, however, surrounded an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] which would later serve as a [[Jedi asteroid|sanctuary]] for survivors of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="LotJ: DW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning]]''</ref>
